parity_checker.name: parity_checker
parity_checker.description: Check whether an integer x is even
parity_checker.smt2_certificate:
(set-logic QF_BV)
; Input Bit-Vector Declarations
(declare-const x (_ BitVec 64))
; Synthesized Circuit SSA Instructions
(define-fun step_0_r11 () (_ BitVec 64) (bvxor x (_ bv1 64)))
(define-fun circuit_out () (_ BitVec 64) (bvand step_0_r11 (_ bv1 64)))
(define-fun spec_out () (_ BitVec 64) (bvand (ite (= (bvurem x (_ bv2 64)) (_ bv0 64)) (_ bv1 64) (_ bv0 64)) (_ bv1 64)))
; Assert negation of universal equivalence: exists x s.t. circuit(x) != spec(x)
(assert (not (= circuit_out spec_out)))
(check-sat)

bitwise_xor_diff.name: bitwise_xor_diff
bitwise_xor_diff.description: Compute the symmetric bit difference (XOR) of 64-bit integers x and y
bitwise_xor_diff.lisp_module:
(module bitwise_xor_diff
  (inputs (x :bits 64) (y :bits 64))
  (outputs (result :bits 64))
  (circuit
    (let ((result (bit-xor x y)))
      result))
  (specification
    (assert (= result (bit-xor x y)))))

clear_lowest_set_bit.name: clear_lowest_set_bit
clear_lowest_set_bit.description: Clear the lowest set bit of x using x & (x - 1)
clear_lowest_set_bit.lisp_module:
(module clear_lowest_set_bit
  (inputs (x :bits 64))
  (outputs (result :bits 64))
  (circuit
    (let ((t0 (sub x 1)))
      (let ((result (bit-and x t0)))
        result)))
  (specification
    (assert (= result (bit-and x (sub x 1))))))

modular_add_inc.name: modular_add_inc
modular_add_inc.description: Compute 64-bit modular sum with carry-in increment (x + y + 1)
modular_add_inc.lisp_module:
(module modular_add_inc
  (inputs (x :bits 64) (y :bits 64))
  (outputs (result :bits 64))
  (circuit
    (let ((t0 (add x y)))
      (let ((result (add t0 1)))
        result)))
  (specification
    (assert (= result (add (add x y) 1)))))
modular_add_inc.smt2_certificate:
(set-logic QF_BV)
; Input Bit-Vector Declarations
(declare-const x (_ BitVec 64))
(declare-const y (_ BitVec 64))
; Synthesized Circuit SSA Instructions
(define-fun step_0_r4 () (_ BitVec 64) (bvadd x y))
(define-fun step_1_r11 () (_ BitVec 64) (bvadd step_0_r4 (_ bv1 64)))
(define-fun circuit_out () (_ BitVec 64) step_1_r11)
(define-fun spec_out () (_ BitVec 64) (bvadd (bvadd x y) (_ bv1 64)))
; Assert negation of universal equivalence: exists x s.t. circuit(x) != spec(x)
(assert (not (= circuit_out spec_out)))
(check-sat)

branchless_mux.name: branchless_mux
branchless_mux.description: Branchless bit-multiplexer selecting x where mask z is 1 and y where z is 0
branchless_mux.lisp_module:
(module branchless_mux
  (inputs (x :bits 64) (y :bits 64) (z :bits 64))
  (outputs (result :bits 64))
  (circuit
    (let ((result (select z x y)))
      result))
  (specification
    (assert (= result (select z x y)))))
branchless_mux.smt2_certificate:
(set-logic QF_BV)
; Input Bit-Vector Declarations
(declare-const x (_ BitVec 64))
(declare-const y (_ BitVec 64))
(declare-const z (_ BitVec 64))
; Synthesized Circuit SSA Instructions
(define-fun step_0_r11 () (_ BitVec 64) (bvor (bvand z x) (bvand (bvnot z) y)))
(define-fun circuit_out () (_ BitVec 64) step_0_r11)
(define-fun spec_out () (_ BitVec 64) (bvor (bvand z x) (bvand (bvnot z) y)))
; Assert negation of universal equivalence: exists x s.t. circuit(x) != spec(x)
(assert (not (= circuit_out spec_out)))
(check-sat)
